title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 62
description: Ten questions on Psalms 62: resting in God alone, the rock and fortress, the emptiness of men and riches, and power and loving kindness belonging to God.

questions.text: In whom does the psalmist's soul rest, according to verse 1?
questions.explanation: Psalms 62:1 says, "My soul rests in God alone."

questions.text: What does the psalmist say he will never be in verse 2?
questions.explanation: Psalms 62:2 says, "I will never be greatly shaken."

questions.text: What do the attackers want to throw him down like in verse 3?
questions.explanation: Psalms 62:3 compares him to a leaning wall and a tottering fence.

questions.text: They bless with their mouth, but what do they do inwardly?
questions.explanation: Psalms 62:4 says they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly.

questions.text: How does the psalmist tell his soul to wait for God in verse 5?
questions.explanation: Psalms 62:5 says, "My soul, wait in silence for God alone."

questions.text: What are the people told to pour out before God?
questions.explanation: Psalms 62:8 says, "Pour out your heart before him."

questions.text: According to verse 9, men of low degree are just what?
questions.explanation: Psalms 62:9 says men of low degree are just a breath.

questions.text: If riches increase, what does verse 10 say?
questions.explanation: Psalms 62:10 says, "If riches increase, don't set your heart on them."

answers.text: Don't set your heart on them

questions.text: What has the psalmist heard twice, according to verse 11?
questions.explanation: Psalms 62:11 says God has spoken once and twice he has heard that power belongs to God.

answers.text: That wisdom belongs to the old
That the land belongs to Israel
That riches belong to the king

questions.text: According to what does the Lord reward every man?
questions.explanation: Psalms 62:12 says, "You reward every man according to his work."
